parameters.query: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.area, u.city, u.profile_complete, u.jersey_name, u.jersey_number, (SELECT s.role FROM app_user_sports s WHERE s.user_id = u.id AND s.sport = $2) AS position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournaments t WHERE t.organizer_user_id = u.id AND t.kind = 'QUICK' AND t.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS today FROM app_users u WHERE u.phone = $1 AND u.is_active = 1
